notes.title: Introducing a New Era of Music Experience – AmazeVR Concerts!
notes.content:
We have hit an exhilarating milestone for our team at AmazeVR and are thrilled to announce the launch of our groundbreaking VR concert platform:

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436210/AmazeVR_Concerts/]AmazeVR Concerts[/url][/b]

After more than three years of tireless effort and relentless innovation from our dedicated teams in the United States and Korea, we've brought this vision to life. Every line of code, each design, and every decision have converged to this momentous day.

Just as Spotify transformed how people listen to music, AmazeVR will revolutionize how we experience it. Imagine being able to have a personal encounter with your favorite artists through their VR concerts anytime, anywhere.

We're both proud and humbled to have collaborated with an array of amazing artists who have courageously embraced our vision of forging a new paradigm in the music industry. They've unlocked the limitless possibilities that VR technology offers, enabling us to envision a future where we're not just listening to music, but living it.

We're profoundly grateful to our team for their unwavering commitment, to our artists for their trust in our vision, and most importantly, to you, our community, for your support and faith in AmazeVR.

Join us as we embark on this extraordinary journey to redefine the limits of musical experiences.

Let's Amaze the world together.

notes.title: Don't just stream music, step into it 🎶
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has downloaded and experienced the AmazeVR Megan Thee Stallion VR Concert app. Your overwhelming support has been truly incredible, and we're thrilled to announce the next chapter in our VR concert journey.

Introducing: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436210/AmazeVR_Concerts/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=pdp&utm_campaign=visibility&utm_content=steam_launch]AmazeVR Concerts[/url]! 🌟

Prepare to be captivated as the boundaries between reality and imagination blur. AmazeVR Concerts is your passport to a realm where music transcends the confines of traditional venues and transports you to magical stages.

Wishlist Now, Launching June 30th

notes.title: AmazeVR Takes Triple Platinum at Vega Digital Awards 2023!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that AmazeVR Megan Thee Stallion VR Concert earned not one but THREE platinum awards at this year’s Vega Digital Awards competition. VR & 360 Video – Dance & Performance, Music, and Best Performance categories. 

The Vega Digital Awards highlights the vital role of digital pioneers in an ever-changing digital landscape. We are humbled to be sharing the winner’s circle with gaming titans like League of Legends, PubG and FIFA 23. 

We would like to thank the Vega Digital Awards judges, and most of all our fans for their support and for recognizing AmazeVR as the next stage of music!

notes.title: Launch day is here!
notes.content:
Dear fellow music lovers,

We are thrilled to share with you the launch of our VR Concert app on SteamVR! As indie developers, we are passionate about creating immersive experiences that bring fans closer to their favorite artist to create lasting memories. Music has the power to connect us in ways that words cannot, and we believe that VR technology can take that connection to the next level.

Our journey began back in 2015, when we founded AmazeVR and started creating 180 and 360 VR experiences for the Oculus Rift. We explored different genres like music, dance, horror, and tourism, but it wasn't until 2021 that we decided to focus on concerts. We knew that music was the universal language that could unite people of all backgrounds, and we wanted to create an experience that was intimate and personal.

Our first VR Concert experience with Megan Thee Stallion was a dream come true. We were able to tour the United States, bringing our VR headsets to 15 cities and giving fans the opportunity to experience the concert in a way they never had before. We synced 100+ VR headsets to play at the same time, ensuring that every fan had a front-row seat to the show, regardless of whether they had their own VR headset. Seeing the reactions of our fans going viral on TikTok was one of the most rewarding experiences we've had as developers.

We knew then that we had to make our concerts accessible to more people, and we released our app on the Meta App Lab Store and Pico Store. And now, we're excited to bring our concerts to even more people with our SteamVR launch. We're dedicated to creating the most immersive experience possible for our fans, and we're constantly innovating to make it even better.

As music lovers ourselves, we understand the importance of seeing artists perform up-close. Our VR concerts are designed to do just that - to bring people closer to artists than ever before. We believe that VR technology has the power to change the way we experience music, and we're committed to making that happen.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait for you to experience our VR concerts on SteamVR.

With love and appreciation,
Team AmazeVR
